description: This file defines a ProfileFragment class for an Android app, handling user authentication and profile management, including sign in/up, display of user info, and updating profile details.

classes.name: ProfileFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing user profile UI, authentication, and profile updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, binds UI elements, and sets up click listeners for sign in, sign up, save profile, and sign out actions.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the UI based on whether a user is currently signed in or not, showing/hiding relevant sections and displaying user info.
